_comment_: Production overrides for the AgentBoard Proposal Worker.
Drop this file beside AgentBoard.ProposalWorker.exe in the publish
What this file does vs. appsettings.json:
* Fills in Worker.Id (stable per-machine identifier; the value
ends up in /health worker_id so the server can route follow-up
* Points Agents.* at a config that explicitly grants unattended access
/ -y. The CliLocator auto-discovers codex / minimax / codebuddy
on disk if Command is left empty.
* Hardens Portal.Urls (binds 0.0.0.0 only if you also need LAN
What this file does NOT do:
* It does not store API keys. Set MINIMAX_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY
in the worker process environment (the installer persists a
* It does not configure RabbitMq.Uri. Either put it in
AGENTBOARD_MQ_URL in the env or fill in below.

WorkBuddy._comment_: CliLocator finds WorkBuddy's extensionless codebuddy script
WorkBuddy._comment_2: and launches it through node.exe automatically.

MiniMax._comment_: minimax CLI is auto-discovered via npm-global bin. --full-access
MiniMax._comment_2: is enforced by the model behaviour: minimax-cli -p has no
MiniMax._comment_3: tool-call approval gate, so the prompt is the only constraint.

Codex._comment_: codex is auto-discovered from PATH or known install locations.
Codex._comment_2: The bypass flag is required for unattended full-access execution.
Codex._comment_3: Remove it and choose a sandbox policy if interactive approval is acceptable.

Portal._comment_: Bind 0.0.0.0:<port> only on machines you intend to expose to
Portal._comment_2: the LAN. 127.0.0.1 is safer; use an SSH tunnel if needed.
